newsitem.title: UK: Brazil to launch 10-yr sterling bond soon - bankers.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to launch 10-yr sterling bond soon - bankers.

text.p: Brazil will launch a 10-year sterling-denominated Eurobond as early as next week, bankers said on Friday.
"The bond may come as early as next week," a banker said, adding: "The deal is about tapping a new investor base."
The offering is expected to be for up to 200 million stg with a 10-year maturity. Unofficial price talk is 250-275 basis points over gilts.
BZW and CSFB are joint lead managers of the transaction.
Central Bank International Affairs Director Gustavo Franco met with investors in London on Friday.
Due to U.S. regulations the event could not be reported on, bu, bankers said after the presentation that Franco said Brazil wanted to restructure its debt, particularly its Brady bonds.
